listenings.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Murat Kaya and I am on the organising committee. A few practical things before Monday. Registration is going to open at eight in the morning, on the ground floor, and you will need the confirmation email on your phone. Do not print it. The workshops are small, only twenty people each, so if you want a place you have to sign up online, and the deadline is Friday at midnight. There is no waiting list this year. The networking dinner is on Wednesday, and the buses are going to leave from the main entrance at seven. One last thing. The full schedule is in the app, and the app is the only version we will update.

Dejair, hello, this is Priya. I hope you remember me from the last congress. I saw your name on the participant list for Bangkok, so I am sending you this message. Two things. First, I am going to present in the session on nerve damage, on Tuesday morning, and I would really like you to be there, because your work on leprosy is closer to mine than anybody else's on that programme. Second, a group of us are going to have dinner on the Monday evening, before everything gets busy. It is nothing formal, just six or seven people who work on pain. Come. I will send you the address on Monday.
